SEVENTH, SLOWLY. — BOROUGH DRIVE

Original game code, car, street furniture, sky/road shaders and synthesized audio:
Copyright (c) 2026 Rayid Ali and Borough Drive contributors. MIT License.
The music is an original generated chord loop, reproduced by
model-source/make_seventh_audio.py; no commercial recording is sampled.
See LICENSE.txt for the original-code license.

Engine: Godot 4.7.2, MIT. Godot Engine contributors; Juan Linietsky,
Ariel Manzur. Full engine and third-party notices: godot-notices.txt.
https://godotengine.org/license/

Geography: © OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL 1.0.
https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright
NYC OTI building footprints; DCP PLUTO 26v2; DOHMH/DCWP dated records.
https://cityofnewyork.github.io/opendatatsm/publicpolicies.html
The City does not sponsor this project. These are dated geographic records,
estimated details and architectural observations, not a current field survey.

Some modeled sign lettering derives from Damion Regular, Copyright 2014
The Damion Project Authors, SIL Open Font License 1.1. See DAMION-OFL.txt.

Existing First & Seventh model geometry was converted from Borough Drive's
source recipes without introducing new photographic observations. Lofi colors,
weather and additional street props are authored atmosphere. Business names,
wall markings and proportions retain the parent's documented uncertainties.
No new reference photographs are bundled with this slice.

Complete inherited source credits: ../reconstruction/ASSET-CREDITS.md
Dated source inventory: ../reconstruction/neighborhood-sources.json
Source distribution and photographic provenance:
https://github.com/rayidali/borough-drive
THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md and model-source/NEIGHBORHOOD-NOTES.md in that repository.

The original project's licensed core photographs, source-specific notices,
geographic database licenses and other third-party rights remain applicable
to their respective materials. MIT covers only original contributions.
Business names and signs do not imply endorsement or grant trademark rights.
